title: Strategy '2': per-list pricing and best price (guide fig. 2)
summary: Drill-down of "Best-price selection": each matching price list priced on its own, best price, campaign/volume steps and result shaping. Mapped from field guide inputs/dsp-price-calculation.html (sha256:d260ad4216e3); every node is tagged confirmed / design-only / conflicting / code-only against code. Conceptual stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

sources.note: Lines 197-299: gross list (tenant rule); discounts resolved once; for each price list in turn: campaign/limit prices (per-campaign discounts when configured), line-discount LIMT values as volume steps (cheapest per required quantity kept), standard price -> lowest net wins.
Lines 301-349: no list -> no price; order-total discount (limit <= 1); result = selected price + campaign/limit steps + order-total + future overrides; NetPriceUsed prices skip discounts.

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

Price Discount Calculation: OGDIPO by OCUSMA.DISY (<= 8 DIPO), allocated discount number (Optimera/Flisekompaniet position 4 for agreement prices), OGDMTX 10 template field sets (PC11..PC91, PC01 = 10) with PREX, LIMT <= requested quantity, SGGB 22/32 + SGGC + SGGU scale limit, DITP/DIBE/DIRE calculation, DDSU presentation (per line vs order total).

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256.
The field guide is a secondary summary (draw.io figures were unreadable to its author); Confluence pages and code are the cited evidence.
Gross-price rule and direct-delivery variant are code-only and stay at the parent level (no guide content).
New nested layer id: auto-layout on first open; no dsp-arch-pos carryover; existing parent ids/positions unchanged.
